Topic 7.2: Reading 7.2.1 Extensive Reading: Independent Reading

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 7.2.1 Extensive Reading: Independent Reading, part of Strand 7 in Grade 4 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why should we read different types of materials? 2. What kind of materials do you enjoy reading? 3. What can you do to remember what you read?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 7.2.1 Extensive Reading: Independent Reading together.

3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: This is developed as the learner exchanges ideas during school reading clubs.

• Learning to Learn: This is enhanced as the learner sources for information on their own.

Values:
● Respect: It is developed as the learner appreciates opinions of others when sharing reflections on the text

● Integrity: It is portrayed as the learner displays honesty when selecting appropriate reading material.

(PCIs):

• Safety and Security education: It is inculcated through the theme of cyber safety

• Self-awareness: This is developed when learners acquire ability to describe themselves through interactive language
